info.title: Uptivra API
info.description: Single-tenant monitoring. Collections return arrays, monitors up to 1000, checks/incidents newest 100. Statistics use recorded checks in the last 24 hours. JSON bodies limited to 32 KiB; errors use {error}. No cross-origin browser API access.

servers.description: Same-origin dashboard proxy; use your deployment origin in production.
Direct Go backend; bypass the frontend proxy for scheduler requests.
Direct Go backend; bypass the frontend proxy for scheduler requests.

put.summary: Change password and revoke all sessions

post.description: Write scope required. Only monitor endpoints you are authorized to test.

put.description: Write scope. Invalidates active claims and resets threshold counters; preserves incident state.

get.summary: Read status page and retention settings

put.summary: Replace status page and retention settings

post.summary: Generate or replace a heartbeat token
post.description: Session only, with same-origin validation. Invalidates the previous token; plaintext returned once. Heartbeat monitors only.

201.description: One-time token and relative receipt path

post.description: Outbound bot signal; no request body. Requires this monitor’s token, not an administrator session. Disabled monitors reject receipts. Receipt is evaluated by the scheduler and does not create a check immediately.

put.summary: Change the group for future incident notifications; queued deliveries are retained

post.summary: Append incident details and queue group-scoped notifications; checks control recovery

409.description: Limit of 100 updates per incident reached

post.description: Requires Origin and configured SETUP_CODE. Five global attempts per 15 minutes; unavailable after the first account exists.

post.summary: Owner transfers ownership to another administrator
post.description: Atomic transfer; current owner cannot be deleted. Returns 204.
Session only. Up to 60 retries per 15 minutes. Clears old fencing tokens; 404 if not failed.
Session only. Up to 20 tests per 15 minutes. Delivered by the scheduler with normal retry and SSRF protection.
Session only. Start within one year; duration up to 30 days or less than seven days if weekly. Weekly repeats every 168 hours in UTC. Cancels in-flight claims.

get.summary: Read measured availability and missing coverage
get.description: UTC calendar days including today. Samples establish coverage for at most their recorded cadence. Legacy samples without cadence establish no coverage. Latest 100 overlapping incident durations are returned. Read API keys are also accepted on the authenticated route.

apiKey.description: up_ token, read or write. Read keys can access sensitive monitor headers. Write includes read. Cannot manage account/channels/keys.

session.name: uptivra_session
session.description: 12-hour HttpOnly session; mutations require exact APP_ORIGIN in Origin header.

cron.description: CRON_SECRET only; call backend directly, not the 15-second Next.js proxy.

heartbeat.description: Per-monitor heartbeat token. Only its hash is stored.

type.description: Immutable. Omitted means HTTP for legacy monitors.

grace_seconds.description: Heartbeat lateness allowance, added to interval_seconds.

MonitorInput.description: PUT replaces all writable fields; omitted booleans are false and omitted headers clear existing secrets. Length limits on server are UTF-8 bytes. Heartbeats use an empty URL, no headers/content, and timeout/status zero. HTTP fields are unused for heartbeats.

url.description: Public HTTP(S), port 80 or 443; DNS and redirects checked on connection.

reason.description: Sanitized code; e.g. network_error, status_mismatch, content_mismatch.

signing_secret.description: Required for webhook; ignored for Discord.

group.description: Null selects all groups (default); empty string selects ungrouped monitors. Otherwise matches a monitor group exactly, including case. Limited to 80 UTF-8 bytes.
